preparation.scope: static metadata/source binding before experiment; no trained model forward or input selection

limits: M-A-only test after both new mechanisms failed5a; not a successful three-mechanism algorithm claim; numerical results not G3 proof

launch.scope: immutable snapshot preparation and launch; controller records online stage execution separately; no second writer

selection.review: All frozen exclusion indices, ascending scan completeness, common clean-correct selection and44 published file identities checked; no model forward rerun, not numerical bound reproof.

first_pair_review.interpretation: Both full requests TIMEOUT; same engine/input/property and prefix policy. Incomplete V2 phases were not accepted. No paired gain/loss or general efficacy inference.
first_pair_review.process_cost_scope: tool-observed whole audit/document process including imports; separate from online requests

public_main_review.scope: saved public main PGD/census only; no new forwards/solves or numerical proof
public_main_review.limits: Observed histories are sampled native executions, not exact real tie-legal reachability. One observed history does not prove route stability. Candidate counts are numerical interval upper estimates, not exact legal counts. Failed PGD is not safety; no main endpoint denominator changes.
public_main_review.process_cost_scope: whole tool-observed process including imports and record write, separate from online requests

first_positive_pair_review.interpretation: Shared complete numerical positives, zero gain/loss. One verified history plus numerical-policy prefix exclusions covers14400 directory histories; not independently proved routing or source-complete SAFE. M-A closes without coupled fallback but costs more on this pair; no population cost inference.
first_positive_pair_review.process_cost_scope: tool-observed whole review process including imports/record write, separate from online calls

first_input_review.interpretation: One complete input block out of20; no bootstrap or admission decision. Original numerical positives and timeouts unchanged; no public-counterexample conflict observed. Same-source engine/coverage/cascade receipt audit is not source-complete proof.
first_input_review.process_cost_scope: tool-observed whole record review including imports and writing, separate from original online requests

first_gain_review.interpretation: First contemporaneous complete-request M-A-only numerical positive against coupled timeout. Five histories close through ten initial alpha-CROWN endpoint analyses without BaB or coupled fallback. Baseline stopped in its first common history. Different partial pruning counts reflect traversal progress, not a pruning-algorithm change. No population advantage, independently proved route change, or G3 source-complete certificate is inferred.
first_gain_review.process_cost_scope: tool-observed whole review process including imports and record write; separate from online calls

second_gain_review.process_cost_scope: read-only frozen source audit including imports; separate from online calls
second_gain_review.interpretation: Second paired gain occurs on the same input1743, not a second independent input. All three histories close in V2; five endpoints at initial alpha-CROWN and one through nonlinear BaB. Off times out on the first shared history. No full-study or strict-proof conclusion.

prior_readonly_review.scope: earlier frozen-source reception check; no new model or solver calls; separately charged

second_input_review.interpretation: Second of20fixed input blocks, all15models. Paired numerical positives and complete costs only; no interim bootstrap/admission decision, no independently checked route-changing or source-complete proof. Negative residual-family prefix and all timeouts retained.
second_input_review.process_cost_scope: tool-observed whole review process including imports and record write, separate from online calls
